name: Garlic-Herb Babka Wreath with Camembert and Cranberry Jam
subtitle: A braided sharing wreath with baked cheese and tart-spiced jam
description: Make a savory garlic-herb babka wreath, bake it around a wheel of camembert, and serve with cranberry jam and optional charcuterie accompaniments.

ingredients.item: strong white bread flour plus extra for dusting
a few rosemary and sage sprigs
ingredients.preparation: plus extra rosemary sprigs to garnish
halved, sliced pears, dates, walnuts, almonds, cured meats and cheeses, or any charcuterie accompaniments of your choice, to serve (optional)

instructions.text: Mix the flour, yeast, and 1 tablespoon sugar. Add the beaten eggs and enough water to form a soft dough, then knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover, and let it prove for 2 hours, or until doubled in size.
Cook the cranberries, 100 g sugar, and chilli flakes over medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring until thick. Cool completely.
Mix the softened butter with the garlic, parsley, and leaves from the rosemary and sage sprigs. Chill for 1 hour to firm slightly.
Roll the dough on a floured surface into a large rectangle. Spread with the herb butter, leaving a narrow border.
Roll the dough tightly from one long side, then cut the log lengthwise to expose the filling. Twist the halves together, keeping the cut sides facing upward.
Shape the twisted dough into a wreath on a lined baking tray, joining the ends. Set the camembert in the center and let the wreath rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Brush the dough with beaten egg and prepare the camembert for baking according to its package directions, ensuring it is vegetarian if needed.
Bake for about 35 minutes, until the wreath is golden brown and the cheese is soft. If the camembert is baked separately, keep it warm while the wreath finishes.
Cut the wreath into portions, garnish with rosemary, and serve with the cranberry jam, camembert, and optional accompaniments.

equipment: stand mixer or hands for kneading
